narrative: The AI trade has roared back, driving a strong rebound in both the Nasdaq 100 and the S&P 500 on the back of momentum in names like CoreWeave and Nvidia. Market sentiment is further supported by Anthropic's reportedly oversubscribed IPO, though questions linger regarding elevated capital expenditures and data center capacity. Macro headwinds remain prevalent as robust US economic growth fuels inflation concerns and pushes 10-year Treasury yields near 5%. Consequently, rate hike bets for the Fed's December meeting have surged, strengthening the US dollar. Lower oil prices, however, are acting as a positive tailwind for equity markets.

Nasdaq.why: Anchors highlighted a strong rebound in the index driven by renewed momentum across AI-related names.

S&P 500.why: Anchors reported that the index recovered most of its recent losses, supported by broad-based market gains.

Gold.why: Gold was not covered in the notes.

Oil.why: Anchors noted that crude prices have declined, which is serving as a positive input for equities.
